reviews.title: You tube tv sucks
reviews.text: Youtube TV is by far the most confusing and worst app that I've ever used. To sign up through my tv, I was provided a QR code. I used the QR code and logged into my Google account.  Then nothing. I tried this four or five times before giving up on the QR code and trying to go directly to the website that the QR code was referencing.  Once I did this, I had success. I was under the impression that the trial that I had signed up for would give me access to a Broncos game that I was trying to watch for American football.  Which it did for about thirty minutes, then said my viewing time was up.  So then I had no reason to pay for YouTube TV, so then I went to try to cancel. I went through the same loop, but this time even more confusing, to cancel my subscription. Finally, going to a computer and going to the website directly and was able to cancel.  Most people use phones these days. Using a browser on a computer short be the easiest way to sign up or cancel a subscription to a service that is most obviously not for computer use. For this reason I will never use YouTube TV or subscribe to anything YouTube or Google for that matter ever again. Horrible experience and I feel that the company is just trying to make it hard so I forget about it and my trial runs up and they're able to charge me.  By the way, nobody I know likes YouTube TV. Everybody thinks it sucks. I've never met one person who was like 'Wow, YouTube TV, it's really good'.

reviews.title: Worst customer service and deceptive advertising
reviews.text:
I recently decided to give YouTube TV a chance to earn my business by starting a free trial. I only wanted the sports package but their clunky subscription pages only enabled a trial for the full package, so I started that expecting to downgrade if I chose to start a paid subscription.
Overall, I found it to be useful but WAY too expensive for a full plan at full price. But the sports plan at a discounted rate of $42.99 seemed fair. But they then refused to offer that promo rate because I took the trial for the full package (because their site wouldn’t process a sports trial even though advertising one as available).
I called customer service (in India of course) and they said there was no way they could override their policies. I asked to speak with a manager and they said no one was available.
We went round and round for 20+ minutes getting nowhere. They preferred to lose a customer rather than honor their own advertised promotions. Shame!

reviews.title: Extra commercials, hard to navigate
reviews.text: The app, especially the Apple TV app, is difficult to navigate. The search feature is nearly useless; unless you spell it exactly, and you better be sure the title is correct. And don’t get me started with the on demand video adds; if you complete the 6 or more adds in the middle of your program and then try to back it up because it randomly cut a key conversation short, you’ll be watching this adds all over again. The app in short is annoying. The pricing is atrocious. And if wasn’t for the Sunday Ticket I’d never purchase it.

reviews.title: Overpriced and Difficult to cancel
reviews.text:
I took advantage of the 10 day trial, with intention of cancelling before being billed $85 for a month of service.

The price is far too high for me, considering that I just want to watch one football game per week.

Cancelling should be easy like with every other subscription based streaming service, but it isn’t.  After being sent to a website, my TV subscriptions settings, Google Play subscriptions page and the app itself, I was unable to find a cancel button.  I had to call and wait on hold, and answer questions about my decision.  Instead of apologizing for the inconvenience, they wanted me to consider how my family feels about the app and if they would like to keep it.

It’s pretty scummy for YoutubeTV to run the same playbook as the cable providers.

What this translates to is that even is you start watching 20 mins behind you will never catch up live while you are forced to watch the same commercials over and over like some dystopian novel.   I actually was considering buying a Kia EV bit after watching the same commercial 12 times in now have developed a gag response to the brand.  This is all on top of how cryptic it is to navigate in the app as each type of device has its own nuances.  In other words, the app is not easy to use but it sure knows how to make money off your misery!!!   Awesome job User Experience team   Folks, avoid this at all cost!!!   I will be canceling and going back to Xfinity.
